coverage_cases: S10 non-ASCII staged path is refused AND counted as scanned
S11 an unreadable staged blob is refused, not skipped
S12 the R5 net reaches the non-ASCII path family
isolation: every case runs in a throwaway git repository under a temporary directory; the real repository is never staged, committed or modified

rows.name: S2 a staged file whose CONTENT is a bare 64-hex token is REFUSED (the value shape, not just the file name)
S3 a staged credential assignment is REFUSED
S4 a staged PEM private-key header is REFUSED
S5 an ordinary evidence file is ACCEPTED -- including one carrying a 64-hex DIGEST inside a JSON field (a digest is not a bare token)

detail.content_check: an exempted path whose content is NOT the stub is refused as R0_exempted_path_without_stub_marker

rows.name: S6 the REDACTION STUB at a secret path is ACCEPTED when the path is explicitly exempted (the remedy stays committable), and it is content-checked too
S6b an allow-listed PATH carrying NON-stub content is REFUSED: an exemption cannot be borrowed by a file that merely sits at an allowed path

detail.why: the index is what becomes public; scanning the worktree would both miss staged blobs and cry wolf over uncommitted scratch

rows.name: S7 the scanner reads the INDEX, not the working tree: a clean index with a dirty worktree is ACCEPTED, and a dirty index with a clean worktree is REFUSED

detail.reported_by: path + line number + rule id only

rows.name: S8 the scan output NEVER carries a value: no staged literal appears and no finding carries a value/line-content field
S9 the DELIVERY path invokes the scanner before it commits, so the control is on the real route and not only available to a careful caller

detail.why: a control that silently narrows its own scope is worse than no control, because it is trusted

rows.name: S10 a staged file under a NON-ASCII path is REFUSED and is COUNTED as scanned: the coverage hole that let `CLEAN (0 scanned)` stand over an unread file is closed
S11 a staged entry whose blob cannot be read is REFUSED as R5_staged_blob_unreadable, not silently skipped
S12 the same unreadable entry at a NON-ASCII path is REFUSED as R5, and the entry is enumerated at all

synthetic_values_only: an absent-object index entry (a syntactically valid 64-hex oid that is not in the object database)
